name: My Lord In Red
source:
A cursed vampire, barely kept alive by the blood of a man who saved him, decides to give up. His loyal servant, unwilling to accept his decision, makes a selfish choice.

Tonight... they will both have to face the consequences.

[From [url=https://ultratrashdog.itch.io/my-lord-in-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个被诅咒的吸血鬼，靠着救他的人的血勉强维持生命，决定放弃。他忠诚的仆人不愿意接受他的决定，做出了自私的选择。

今晚……他们都将不得不面对后果。

[来自[url=https://ultratrashdog.itch.io/my-lord-in-red]itch.io[/url]]
